notes: Uses the challenge's 36 desks (rule 12), but 'think again about the move' doesn't say what the recommendation becomes (rule 13).

responses.value: Move to the smaller office when the lease ends in 8 months. Badge data show only about 15 of 40 desks in use on a typical day, and an office half the size costs $320,000 a year against $600,000, saving $280,000 a year, so the $150,000 move pays back in about 6 months. The main risk is crowding on busy days. The next step is to check desk use on the busiest days and set up desk booking before signing.
Update. With 36 desks used midweek, a half-size office won't fit everyone, so we should think again about the move.
